title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
abstract: arXiv:2610.40551v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. translated_title: 拉马努金挑战赛结果：面向多格式证明的AI辅助评估流水线
translated_abstract: 随着AI数学能力的快速提升，有意义的基准测试正从大学水平的问题和数学奥林匹克竞赛转向研究级数学。拉马努金挑战赛是一个由数论研究级问题组成的基准测试，其中包括未发表的结果和公开猜想。该挑战赛提出了数学常数的具体公式，其正确性可以通过数值方法验证，而其证明可能需要非显而易见的数学方法。在本文中，我们分析了挑战赛的提交作品，衡量了不同AI模型、计算机代数系统（CAS）和形式化工具的相对成功率。我们发现了与官方解答在概念上截然不同的正确提交作品，以及其中一个已公开猜想的证明。评估这些提交作品暴露了第二个挑战：如何可靠地大规模评判复杂证明。为此，我们引入了一种AI辅助评估流水线，用于处理自然语言证明、CAS代码和（形式化证明）
tldr: 本文分析了拉马努金挑战赛（研究级数论基准）的提交结果，发现AI能够证明已公开的猜想并给出与官方解答概念迥异的正确证明，并提出了一种AI辅助的评估流水线，以可靠地大规模评判自然语言、CAS代码等多格式的复杂证明。
en_tdlr: Analyzing Ramanujan Challenge submissions shows that AI can prove a published open conjecture and produce conceptually novel correct proofs, and the paper introduces an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for reliably judging complex multi-format proofs (natural language, CAS code, formal) at scale.
